My five-year plan. My dream is an office in Miami. This year, I want to improve my English. Next year, I want to visit three aviation fairs in the United States. In three years, I would like to expand to Miami. In twenty thirty, success is twenty aircraft sales a year.
Hi Karina! My partners in Miami want to know about your plans. What are your goals for the future?
Good question, Mike. My big dream is to have an office in Miami.
That's great! Why do you want to expand to the United States?
Many of my clients are there. I want to grow my company and sell more aircraft.
I see. And what is your first step?
This year, I would like to improve my English. Then I want to visit more fairs.
Good plan. What does success mean for you?
For me, success is happy clients and twenty aircraft sales a year.
You can achieve that, Karina. Would you like to work with my partners in Miami?
Yes, I'd love to! Let's talk about the next steps.

Hi, I am Rafael Costa, and I have an air taxi company in Rio de Janeiro. Today we have four helicopters and twenty employees. But I have big dreams for the future. I want to grow my company step by step. Next year, I want to buy two new helicopters. In three years, I would like to expand to Sao Paulo and open a second office there. My biggest dream is to fly to all the big cities in Brazil. Success is not fast, but I am ready to work for it.

Hi, it's Anna Brooks, from Brooks Flight School in Texas. Ten years ago, my dream was a flight school. My first step was very small: one plane and two students. Today we have fifteen planes and two hundred students. Now I want to achieve a new goal. I would like to open a school in Brazil, maybe in two years. My tip for you is simple. Write your goals on paper, and look at them every week. Don't wait for the perfect moment. Start today.

First, Mike asks Karina about her goals for the future. Then, Karina says her dream is to have an office in Miami. Next, she says she wants to grow her company and sell more aircraft. After that, she says her first step is to improve her English. Finally, Mike invites her to work with his partners in Miami.
